summary: Depth 30 and Depth 50 on an NSE equity: refused before any subscription, in this member's web adapter's words (Invalid depth level N. Must be 5 or 20), and nothing is subscribed over REST.

notes: Every XTS web adapter refuses a Depth level other than 5 or 20 before it looks the symbol up (if mode == 3 and depth_level not in [5, 20]); the desktop refuses at admission with the same words (feed/refusals.rs depths_accepted), so no REST call is made.
Depth 20 on NSE and NFO is served (depth_twenty); elsewhere the registry's fallback names 5 (XtsBroker::feed_depth_levels).
